transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Hi, doctor. Well, what brings me in is I just keep messing up little things. It's nothing major, but it's getting pretty frustrating. 

Like, I'll write down the wrong time on a class sheet over at the senior center, and then I'm showing up at the wrong hour. Or I'll be working on a project, measure a board once, and still end up cutting it a hair short just because I skipped over the small print on the tape. It's just a lot of careless mistakes like that lately, and I figured I should come in and talk to somebody about it.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory, attention, or ability to think clearly that have been affecting your daily activities?

Well, yeah, I'd say my attention is definitely affecting things. Those mix-ups I mentioned... they actually made me step back from helping lead a couple of DIY workshops recently. I just didn't want to keep making careless mistakes when I'm supposed to be showing other people what to do. 

And at home, my wife has had to start double-checking our plans. She just does it to make sure I don't accidentally throw off our family visits or the other activities I've got going on at the center.
Have you felt down, sad, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy over the past few weeks?

No, I wouldn't say that. I haven't been feeling sad or down at all, really. I still enjoy my hobbies and being at the senior center, even with the mix-ups. I'm just more frustrated with myself than anything else. But no, I haven't lost interest or felt depressed.
Outside of the mix-ups at the senior center and at home, have you found it harder to stay focused or keep things organized in other parts of your life lately?

Yeah, I do have some trouble keeping things organized, especially when there's a lot going on. Like, if I've got a few errands to run, a workshop to prep for, and an appointment all on the same day... I just have a hard time putting them in a logical order. I'll end up starting one thing, stopping halfway through, and then I'm just rushing around at the end of the day trying to get it all done. It just feels like I can't get my ducks in a row sometimes.
Do you find yourself having trouble focusing or getting organized first thing in the morning, even before your day really gets going?

No, not really. The mornings are usually fine. I get up, have my coffee, read the paper... I don't really have any trouble then. It's more when I actually have to start doing things, you know, when the day gets busy and I have a bunch of different things to juggle. But just first thing in the morning? No, I wouldn't say I have trouble then.
Looking back, did you have similar issues with attention or staying organized when you were younger, like when you were in school or as a young adult?

Yeah, I did. Even way back in elementary school, my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was a bright kid, but... well, I was always forgetting my books or losing my homework. I'd spend half the time just staring out the window unless someone was right there to keep me on track. So, yes, it's definitely been an issue since I was young.
